tasks.description: The token-bucket algorithm will be used to enforce rate limits. It will be scoped to each API key, allowing each key to have an independent allowance. This algorithm will ensure that the rate limits are enforced consistently across all server instances.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key, when the token-bucket algorithm is applied, then the rate limit is enforced correctly.

tasks.description: The bucket capacity and refill rate will be made configurable via application configuration. This will allow for easy adjustment of the rate limits without requiring code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration change, when the rate limits are updated, then the new limits are enforced correctly.

tasks.description: The rate-limit counters will be stored in Redis to ensure that the limits are enforced consistently across all server instances. This will require setting up a Redis connection and implementing the necessary logic to store and retrieve the counters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Redis connection, when the rate-limit counters are stored and retrieved, then the counters are accurate and up-to-date.

tasks.description: When a key exceeds its limit, the request will be rejected with an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status. This will prevent abusive or runaway clients from degrading the service.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key that exceeds its limit, when a request is made, then a 429 response is returned.

tasks.description: The Retry-After header will be included on 429 responses to indicate how long the client should wait before retrying. This will help prevent clients from making repeated requests that exceed the rate limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 429 response, when the Retry-After header is included, then the header indicates the correct wait time.

tasks.description: The rate-limiting middleware will be integrated with the API routes to apply the rate limits uniformly to authenticated API traffic keyed by API key.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API route, when the rate-limiting middleware is applied, then the rate limits are enforced correctly.

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for rate-limiting middleware
tasks.description: Unit tests will be written to ensure that the rate-limiting middleware is working correctly and that the rate limits are being enforced as expected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of unit tests, when the tests are run, then the rate-limiting middleware is working correctly.
